scope: Fix Coherent GT fullscreen tide backing store, preserving sweep/death/wake timing.
root_cause: Native renderer displays canvas backing pixels rather than stretching the CSS box. 1280x720 occupies one quarter of a 2560x1440 viewport. Native UI scale also reduces innerWidth.

changes.resolution_source: Settings.getVideoMode() Width/Height in start and frame messages
changes.canvas_backing: Physical game resolution plus 2px edges; geometry scaled via setTransform
changes.layer: Root child with zIndex 10000; existing token fences and cleanup preserved

limits: Native UI verification invoked production tide in the main menu; complete actor-death and wake transition was not replayed in a campaign.
Native UI scale tested at 140%; other scales covered by browser regression only.
